title: Charles Hall's Air Force service records

tellings.quote: Bull BS. He was in the Air Force and I have the record. You have his DD214,

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he served at a secret Nevada test site in the 1960s, really was in the Air Force, and Jesse Michels says he has the proof. Michels says it himself, citing Hall's DD214, the official record the US military gives when someone leaves service: "He was in the Air Force and I have the record." He brings it up against people who doubt Hall's stories from his time there.
